map.指数和=1 为不变、>1 为递增，本工具默认不变，可调弹性试递增。结果仅作经济学: If the elasticity sum=1 returns are constant, >1 increasing; this tool defaults to constant and you can adjust the elasticity to try increasing returns. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only and are not investment advice or a basis for policy; any part involving forecasts or empirical estimates should follow authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.教学演示：演示规模报酬不变（α+1−α=1）时投入同倍产出同倍。: Teaching demo: show that under constant returns to scale (α+1−α=1) doubling inputs doubles output.
